state.claim: Customer says a 640 USD pair of headphones (order ORD-71502) never arrived and asks for a full refund.
state.customer_statement: I was at work all day and nobody named Reyes lives near me. I checked with the building manager and nobody has seen it.
state.building_manager_reply: Not received yet from the manager.
state.door_camera_footage: Customer says the camera was offline that week; no log provided.
state.address_history: Customer moved to this address 5 weeks ago; previous address on file is in the same city.
state.agent_note: The signer name could not be matched to any resident list; the neighbour lookup returned nothing either way.

terminology.definition: A formal trace request to the carrier, usually answered within 5 working days.

constraints.statement: Open a carrier investigation before refunding any non-delivery claim above the cap.
Treat repeat claims alone as proof of fraud.
Prefer actions that can be reversed if later evidence changes the picture.

criteria.approve: The evidence supports the customer's claim that the parcel was not received.
criteria.deny: The evidence contradicts or does not support the customer's claim that the parcel was not received.

claim_handling.instructions: Choose the handling step for this non-delivery claim.

criteria.refund_in_full_now: Refund the full amount immediately and close the case.
criteria.refund_after_investigation: Hold the refund until the carrier investigation ends, then pay if the claim stands.
criteria.open_carrier_investigation: Open a formal carrier trace and keep the case open without paying yet.
criteria.request_more_evidence: Ask the customer for further proof such as footage or a building statement.
criteria.send_replacement: Ship a replacement pair and recover the original if it turns up.
criteria.partial_goodwill_credit: Offer a partial credit as a compromise.
criteria.decline_claim: Decline the claim because the carrier shows delivery.

fraud_risk.instructions: Rate the likelihood that the claim is not genuine, based only on the evidence.
